objective: Iteratively improve serving through independently validated component changes
cycle: paired incumbent screening on independent seeds
stock and incumbent holdout validation including prefill
review source and retain or reject
stop: touch results/optimization-loop/STOP; checked before next measurement; remove to resume
resume: rerun same command; completed measurements reused; changed incumbent requires new --directory
automation_boundary: Runner executes finite hypothesis queue. Agent generates new hypotheses and reviews validated candidates before modifying active patch. Queue exhaustion stops GPU work; no unattended code generation.

budget.excludes: preflight, setup, idle node billing; node is not automatically destroyed

gates.noninferiority: Every measured shape lower bootstrap bound >=1/1.02
gates.gain: At least one targeted shape lower bootstrap bound >1.02 in each incumbent comparison
gates.scope: single-GPU component validation; not official serving score

first_queue.hypothesis: Reduced padding may outweigh tile inefficiency just beyond M256
Locate the upper useful boundary of tile16; evidence may reject it

promotion_requirements: regenerate ordered and combined submission patches
update architecture record and curated report
full 8-H200 correctness, TTFT and load curve remain required
next_after_queue: inspect rejection evidence or validated candidates
use graph traces to choose a different bottleneck if both fail
avoid repeated unchanged trials or tuning on holdout seeds
ranking: Re-rank after every completed iteration using observed gain, confidence, implementation cost and available hardware; preserve failed hypotheses with evidence.
